name: SumUp
description: Manage SumUp merchant accounts, transactions, payouts, checkouts and subaccounts from any AI agent. 6 tools with Bearer-token authentication.
instructions:
This connector interacts with the SumUp API (developer.sumup.com).

**Setup**:
1. Log in to the SumUp Dashboard at https://me.sumup.com.
2. Navigate to **Settings → For Developers** (or Developer Portal).
3. Generate an API Key (Personal Access Token).
4. Set `SUMUP_API_KEY`.

**Authentication**: `Authorization: Bearer ${SUMUP_API_KEY}`.

**Overview of capabilities**:
- Retrieve authenticated merchant account and profile details.
- Query transaction history with date range, status, and pagination filters.
- Fetch specific transaction details by code or ID.
- List payouts and bank settlement batches.
- List customer checkouts and payment links.
- List operator subaccounts.

tools.name: sumup_get_merchant_profile
tools.description: Retrieve the merchant profile and account information associated with the authenticated API key, including merchant code, company name, currency, and country.

tools.name: sumup_list_transactions
tools.description: List transaction history for the authenticated merchant account with filtering by date range, payment status, and pagination.

changes_since.description: Retrieve transactions changed since the given timestamp (ISO 8601 format).

limit.description: Number of transactions to return per page (default 20, max 100).

order.description: Order of transactions by timestamp (default descending).

tools.name: sumup_get_transaction
tools.description: Retrieve detailed information for a specific transaction by transaction ID or transaction code.

id.description: The unique internal ID or transaction code of the transaction.

tools.name: sumup_list_payouts
tools.description: Retrieve payout history and settlement reports transferred to the merchant bank account, filtered by date range.

start_date.description: Start date for payouts filter in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.description: End date for payouts filter in YYYY-MM-DD format.

limit.description: Number of payout records to return (default 20, max 100).

tools.name: sumup_list_checkouts
tools.description: List online checkouts and payment links generated for customers, with optional status and checkout reference filters.

checkout_reference.description: Filter by custom merchant checkout reference string.

tools.name: sumup_list_subaccounts
tools.description: Retrieve operator subaccounts configured under the main merchant account.
